summary: Capital One Auto Receivables LLC and Capital One Prime Auto Receivables Trust 2026-1 filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement for a routine auto-loan securitization. On the September 17, 2026 closing date, sponsor Capital One, National Association transferred motor vehicle retail installment contracts to depositor COAR under a Purchase Agreement, which on-sold them to the Issuer under a Sale Agreement; CONA serves as servicer and Wilmington Trust as indenture trustee, with BNY Mellon as owner trustee and Clayton as asset representations reviewer. No public equity special situation is implicated; no deal terms, premium, or board recommendation stated. Watch pool performance, servicing and delinquency trends rather than risk-arb.
